suggestions.reason: Gives the opening a clear place so the first images can be staged fast.

suggestions.text: Open on an extreme close-up of Bruno's crusty eyes as they blink open on his dog bed.
suggestions.reason: An odd, gross close-up in the first second stops the scroll better than a wide shot.

anchor.quote: Paws that never stop getting licked.

suggestions.text: Bruno licks one red, raw paw nonstop, toes splayed.
suggestions.reason: Each symptom needs its own picture so the image changes as fast as the words.

suggestions.text: Bruno shakes and a cloud of fur drifts down through a sunbeam.
suggestions.reason: Shows the third symptom instead of just naming it.

anchor.quote: Every night I would lick my paws and she would tell me to stop. I could not stop.

suggestions.reason: The story moves to her routines with him, at a new time and place.

anchor.quote: she would tell me to stop

suggestions.text: She looks up from the couch and frowns; Bruno freezes mid-lick, ears flat, then can't help licking again.
suggestions.reason: His guilty face shows the problem with the sound off.

anchor.quote: She tried sprays. She tried shampoos. She switched my food twice.

suggestions.text: Quick montage: she sprays his paws, lathers him in the tub, pours a new kibble — all plain, unlabeled bottles and bags.
suggestions.reason: A fast montage keeps the frustration moving; unlabeled products avoid showing any other brand.

anchor.quote: And I had no way to tell her it was not.

suggestions.text: Bruno watches her from his bed, head on his paws, eyebrows lifting, sad eyes held on her.
suggestions.reason: The emotional low point needs a held, readable face.

anchor.quote: All three of those were coming from the same place. My gut.

suggestions.text: Push into Bruno's belly into a stylized 3D gut: glowing good bacteria flicker out, red sparks race up to his eyes, down to his paws and across his coat.
suggestions.reason: This long explanation needs a moving visual or viewers drop off.

anchor.quote: Then one night she found something.

suggestions.reason: The turn happens here; a new scene marks it.

anchor.quote: A greens powder called Iron Paws.

suggestions.text: ★ Iron Paws screen: Iron Paws bag (front) — in her hands under the kitchen light, label to camera
suggestions.reason: The first Iron Paws mention must show the real bag.

anchor.quote: She mixed it into my food that Thursday night without saying much.

suggestions.text: ★ Iron Paws screen: Iron Paws bag (front) — on the counter beside his bowl as she scoops the powder in
suggestions.reason: Feeding is a required brand moment, so the real bag is in shot.

suggestions.text: Bruno's nose twitches, tail thumping hard as the bowl comes down.
suggestions.reason: The bag label says Chicken flavor, but this spoken line says peanut butter; the editor should decide how to fix it.
Time jumps to the payoff and should read as a new scene.

suggestions.text: She freezes, cloth in midair, mouth falling open as she stares at his clear eyes.
suggestions.reason: The payoff lands when we see it hit her.

suggestions.text: ★ Iron Paws screen: Iron Paws bag (front) — center frame on the floor, Bruno sitting proudly beside it
suggestions.reason: The product claims need the real bag on screen.

anchor.quote: Your pup has been waiting on you.

suggestions.text: ★ Iron Paws screen: Iron Paws bag (front) — end card, fills the frame as Bruno looks into camera
suggestions.reason: The end card must close on the real bag so viewers know what to buy.
